messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads-up  Anya's birthday + 3-year Redwood anniversary is next Thu (May 2). Wed like a low-key hybrid surprise. Vote A/B/C and volunteer for one task in the signup doc: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate
A) Office cupcakes + card
B) Care packages mailed to remote folks + Zoom toast
C) Small desk plant + donation on her behalf
I can run a 5-min Zoom toast at 3:30pm PT. @here

Zoe: A  cupcakes please, gluten-free option available :cake:

Marcus: B  remote here, care package sounds great. I can help pack. :package:

Lena: C  happy to set up the donation link and collect contributions.

Carlos: A  card and $10 from me. Also happy to pick the plant if we go C.

Anya: omg you guys don't tell me!! :pleading_face: (kidding) I'll try to pop in for the toast.

Priya (People Ops): Noted. @PeopleOpsBot please create calendar event + Zoom.

PeopleOpsBot: Event created  "Anya celebration"  May 2  3:30pm PT  Zoom link added  RSVP: 6

Zoe: Anyone with allergies? I'll label GF + nut-free cupcakes.

Marcus: No allergies from me. I'll bring compostable plates and a couple of candles.

Priya (People Ops): Plan so far: Office cupcakes in SF kitchen + care packages for remote. Volunteers: Zoe (GF cupcakes), Carlos (card + $), Marcus (plates/packing), Lena (donation setup). Need 1 more volunteer for postage. Sign up: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate

Priya (People Ops): Also thinking of a short montage video DM clips/photos to me by Tue EOD. :camera:

Anya: ok now i'm nervous but excited :heart:

Priya (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll post final checklist Wed. :party-parrot:
